rationale.risk-routing: formal delegation decision model assigns autonomy tier from S/V/C/D risk
rationale.hitl-workflow: tiered approval gates, reversible bounded delegation, human owner blocks before delivery
rationale.org-governance: named accountability, HWO roles, delegation registry, policy, PMO scaling
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: validation paradox, effort asymmetry, two-speed IT, review bottleneck
rationale.automation-bias: dependency trap, skill erosion, plausibility-trap over-trust of capable humans
rationale.design-only: buildable matrix/tiers/thresholds specified; empirical validation deferred to future work
rationale.agentic: AI produces artifact-granularity output reviewed at delivery gates
rationale.assistive: Tier 1 human-driven AI-assisted piece-by-piece use covered
rationale.risk-quality: validation protocols mitigate AI output quality defects
rationale.risk-overreliance: competence-maintenance principle, adversarial self-check mitigate over-reliance
